title: Avomi CLIQ Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill - Cherry Cola
description: The Avomi Cliq Prefilled Pod + Refill in Cherry Cola offers a rich fusion of classic soda flavour with the deep, fruity notes of Cherry. This nostalgic blend delivers the familiar taste of spiced Cola with a sweet Cherry twist, finished with a bubbly, fizzy sensation for a refreshing vape. Designed for use with the Avomi Cliq Prefilled Pod Kit, this pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill container, both containing 20mg Nicotine Salt e-liquid for extended use and smooth satisfaction. Mesh coil technology enhances flavour clarity and vapour consistency, while the innovative auto-refill system ensures hassle-free reloading. Simply attach the pod and refill container to your Avomi Cliq device for up to 6000 puffs of flavourful mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. Once your pod and refill is empty, simply swap them out for a fresh Avomi Cliq Prefilled Pod + Refill pack, View the full range of Avomi Cliq Prefilled pod kits & Refill Pods
